build_tapas_question_answering: build a TAPAS model for answering questions about tabular data using cell selection and aggregation heads
create_tapas_masked_lm: create a TAPAS masked language model for predicting masked tokens in table-structured inputs
test_tapas_sequence_classification: test the TAPAS sequence classification model for table entailment tasks like TabFact
run_tapas_base_model: run the base TAPAS encoder model with tabular-aware token type embeddings for row, column, and cell structure
